name: Collapsible
description: Radix Collapsible, unstyled. Twelve lines: three re-exports with no classes applied.
intent: One thing that opens and closes, with no group to coordinate.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: A meaningful trigger label that reflects the action
notes: This component applies no styling at all. The chevron, the animation and the spacing are all yours.
The trigger label should say what will be revealed — "Advanced options", not "More".

doNotUse: Several related sections — use ui:accordion, which handles the group and the heading semantics
Content that should be visible by default
Using Collapsible for a group where Accordion belongs

agentRules: Bring your own styling — nothing is applied.
Trigger labels name the content, not the gesture.
